pairs.registryProposal: reveal-without-loss scopes itself to a 'published explanatory page', but its static-frame obligations (capture, print, script failure) apply just as well to a public documentation hub that uses whileInView reveals (GuideCategoryGrid, GuideDiscordCTA). The subject should say whether those obligations travel to long-form/reference surfaces that borrow scroll reveals, or point to the subject that owns them.
